title: Use button to expand device borrowing instructions
goal: Use hidden to control the display, and let aria-expanded synchronously express the expanded state of the button control.
summary: The equipment borrowing page collects the supplementary instructions. The reader can open the description, take a look, and then take it back.
tasks: Let #loan-guide be hidden when the page is opened, and aria-expanded of #toggle-guide be false.
Toggles the hidden state of the description when the button is clicked. Set the button's aria-expanded to true when expanding.
Click again to hide the description and restore aria-expanded to false.

example.note: When the delivery instructions are hidden, the expanded state of the button is false. Reading hidden and negating it will give you the expanded state that the button should report.

hint: hidden is true, which means the content is hidden, so it should be inverted when writing aria-expanded. Directly filling in the same value will cause the two states to be opposite.
